title: Too expensive
body:
I was so dissapointed to find out that I cannot get help from this for free/with lower cost. 
I am sure it is a great app, but I cannot afford to put so much money into it.
It would be amazing if there was a free and a premium version!
author: Kuninkaan tytär

title: latasin sovelluksen
body: sovellus toimii vain maksamalla, tajuan idean mutta en ole valmis maksamaan 18€ kuukaudessa.
